items.title: Sheaves of modules on a ringed space have functorial injective embeddings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of sheaves of modules on a ringed space has enough injectives and in fact functorial injective embeddings (statement lines 714-720). The proof is a complete argument: the assignment sending an open set to the product over its points of functorial injective hulls of the stalks is shown to be a sheaf of modules and to receive an injective canonical map from the given sheaf, using that injectivity can be checked on stalks (proof lines 722-746); and the constructed sheaf is injective because it is built stalkwise from injective modules, with functoriality giving the stronger statement (proof lines 746-764). The non-formal content is the stalkwise construction and the injectivity check. The claim is H2.
